info.name: RentNest
info.description:
# RentNest Backend API

RentNest is a RESTful backend API for a rental property marketplace.

The platform supports three roles:

- Tenant
    
- Landlord
    
- Admin
    

## Features

- JWT Authentication
    
- Role-based Authorization
    
- Property Management
    
- Rental Requests
    
- Stripe Payment Integration
    
- Reviews & Ratings
    
- Dashboard Analytics
    
- Search, Filter & Pagination
    
- Global Error Handling
    
- Input Validation using Zod
    
- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL
    

## Authentication

Protected endpoints require authentication using JWT stored in secure HTTP-only cookies.

## Base URL

[https://rentnest-backend-three.vercel.app/api/v1](https://rentnest-backend-three.vercel.app/api/v1)

request.description:
## Description

Registers a new user as a Tenant or Landlord.

### Access

Public

### Success Response

- 201 Created — User registered successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 400 Bad Request — Validation failed.
    
- 409 Conflict — User already exists.

## Description

Authenticates a user using email and password. On successful login, access and refresh tokens are stored in secure HTTP-only cookies.

### Access

Public

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Login successful.
    

### Error Responses

- 400 Bad Request — Validation failed.
    
- 401 Unauthorized — Invalid email or password.
    
- 403 Forbidden — User account is blocked.
    
- 404 Not Found — User not found.

## Description

Generates a new access token using the refresh token stored in the HTTP-only cookie.

### Access

Authenticated User

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Access token refreshed successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Refresh token missing.
    
- 403 Forbidden — Invalid or expired refresh token.

## Description

Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

### Access

Authenticated User

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Profile retrieved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 404 Not Found — User not found.

## Description

Logs out the authenticated user by clearing the access and refresh token cookies.

### Access

Authenticated User

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Logged out successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.

## Description

Allows an authenticated user to change their account password.

### Access

Authenticated User

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Password changed successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 400 Bad Request — Current password is incorrect.
    
- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 422 Unprocessable Entity — Validation failed.

item.name: 🏠 Rental Request

request.description:
## Description

Submits a rental request for an available property. A tenant cannot request their own property or submit duplicate pending requests.

### Access

Tenant

### Success Response

- 201 Created — Rental request submitted successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 400 Bad Request — Validation failed.
    
- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 403 Forbidden — You cannot request your own property.
    
- 404 Not Found — Property not found.
    
- 409 Conflict — Rental request already exists.

## Description

Cancels a pending rental request submitted by the authenticated tenant.

### Access

Tenant

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental request cancelled successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 403 Forbidden — You are not allowed to cancel this request.
    
- 404 Not Found — Rental request not found.

# Approve Rental Request

## Description

Approves a rental request for a property owned by the authenticated landlord.

### Access

Landlord

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental request approved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 403 Forbidden — You are not the owner of this property.
    
- 404 Not Found — Rental request not found.

# Description

Rejects a rental request for a property owned by the authenticated landlord.

### Access

Landlord

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental request rejected successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 403 Forbidden — You are not the owner of this property.
    
- 404 Not Found — Rental request not found.

# Rental Details

## Description

Retrieves detailed information about a specific rental request.

### Access

Tenant (Own), Landlord (Own Property), Admin

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental details retrieved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.
    
- 403 Forbidden — Access denied.
    
- 404 Not Found — Rental request not found.

# Description

Retrieves all rental requests submitted by the authenticated tenant.

### Access

Tenant

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental requests retrieved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.

## Description

Retrieves all rental requests for properties owned by the authenticated landlord.

### Access

Landlord

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental requests retrieved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.

# Description

Retrieves the rental history for properties owned by the authenticated landlord.

### Access

Landlord

### Success Response

- 200 OK — Rental history retrieved successfully.
    

### Error Responses

- 401 Unauthorized — Authentication required.

item.description:
## Description

Rental Request APIs allow tenants to submit rental requests for available properties.

Landlords can review incoming requests and approve or reject them.

Business rules ensure tenants cannot rent their own properties or submit duplicate pending requests.
